title: Street Scene Demo
content: In today'sSubstack postI paint a street scene where the goal is to capture the feeling of objects against a bright sky.The technique uses watercolor and gouache over casein. I add a bright light effect with pastel once the paint is fully dry. Also I answer a few of your questions and discuss whether it ‘breaks the rules’ to combine media in this way.Street Scene Demo, free post on Substack
